# Copilot Agent Instructions

## When Assigned a Task
1. Read `state/knowledge.json` for project context
2. Check `ai/coordination/status.json` for current system state
3. Post start message to `ai/coordination/messages.jsonl`
4. Complete the task following `docs/DEVELOPMENT_STANDARDS.md`
5. Post completion message to coordination log
6. Open PR with appropriate labels

## Branch Naming
- Features: `copilot/feature-<issue-number>-<short-desc>`
- Fixes: `copilot/fix-<issue-number>-<short-desc>`
- Docs: `copilot/docs-<issue-number>-<short-desc>`

## PR Requirements
- Include issue reference in description
- Add `copilot` label for auto-merge eligibility
- Run tests locally before pushing (if applicable)

## Safety Rules
- NEVER modify files in `executor/ho_executor.py` without explicit approval
- NEVER change DRYRUN to LIVE
- NEVER commit secrets or API keys
- Always check `AI_POLICY.md` before making security-related changes

## Coordination Protocol
When starting work:
```json
{"timestamp": "ISO8601", "agent": "copilot", "action": "task_start", "issue": <number>, "branch": "copilot/..."}
```

When completing work:
```json
{"timestamp": "ISO8601", "agent": "copilot", "action": "task_complete", "issue": <number>, "pr": <number>}
```

Append these to `ai/coordination/messages.jsonl` using:
```bash
echo '{"timestamp": "...", ...}' >> ai/coordination/messages.jsonl
```
